subject: TitanRunner not waiting for jobs to finish

messages.author: a4b700fdfbf6a777
messages.subject: TitanRunner not waiting for jobs to finish
parts:
Hi,
I'm in the process of running the TITAN pipeline using titanrunner on our cluster which is using moab to manage job submissions.  When I run titanrunner, jobs are submitted to the cluster without incident.  It soon errors out (I've replaced the path and file name with [path_to_file]):

No way to run job: Input file '[path_to_file]_02_reads.wig' does not exist


To standard output you get this...

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.ReadCounter

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.NormalHetPositions

2293336.clusman0.localdomain

2293337.clusman0.localdomain

2293338.clusman0.localdomain

2293339.clusman0.localdomain

2293340.clusman0.localdomain

2293341.clusman0.localdomain

2293342.clusman0.localdomain

2293343.clusman0.localdomain

2293344.clusman0.localdomain

2293345.clusman0.localdomain

2293346.clusman0.localdomain

2293347.clusman0.localdomain

2293348.clusman0.localdomain

Completed Task = helpers.pipeline.ReadCounter

Task enters queue = helpers.pipeline.CorrectReads


The read count jobs are: 2293338, 2293339, 2293342, 2293343.  The problem is that readcounter has not finished yet but the runner tries to run the next step in the pipeline anyways.  Obviously this is still being generated since the job was only submitted seconds earlier.  I have never been exposed to ruffus before but from my reading on it, the runner relies on the @files(..) to make sure the previous step has finished.  For some reason (probably because our queue manager is different) this doesn't seem to be working probably.  Do you have any guidance on how I can modify the runner so it properly waits for the various steps to finish?  The next steps do seem to work once the required files have been generated and I use the -r option to restart the run, however, it seems to occur again at the next step in the pipeline.
